pencereler.0-5: Near Novorossiysk, a bulk carrier rammed the Soviet liner Admiral Nakhimov. It sank within
pencereler.5-12: minutes, and four hundred twenty three people died. A pilot radioed a warning to the freighter. The reply was:
pencereler.12-20: don't worry. The freighter didn't slow or turn. The liner's captain had gone to his cabin. The officers exchanged radio calls, but
pencereler.20-30: it was too late. Both captains were sentenced to fifteen years.

segmentler.metin: The SS Admiral Nakhimov sank after a collision near Novorossiysk.
It took only a freighter holding course despite warnings.
So how could a freighter holding course despite warnings do this?
The answer is collision after both captains violated navigation rules and assumed the other would give way — and it is why both captains were jailed and Soviet maritime safety came under scrutiny.
